end.summary:
Kavya discussed Diwali, Pongal, Makar Sankranti and Lohri.
They described Diwali customs: new clothes, rangoli, sweets and fireworks.
They recognised that festivals can be celebrated differently in different regions.
The seasonal reason for harvest festivals remained unclear.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised festival foods, clothes, decorations, flowers and regional differences with Kavya. Kavya shared clear Diwali examples and correctly noted that the same festival may be celebrated differently in different places. The connection between harvest festivals and the January season was still mixed up and was not corrected by the end. At home, look at a Pongal or Makar Sankranti picture together and discuss what is harvested and why the festival is held around that time.
